name: markdown-editor
title: Markdown editor
description: A Tiptap 3 markdown editor over one file: saves against the revision it read, shows a conflict banner on a stale save, and shows the agent's proposed patches as a diff the person accepts. Tools: markdown_go_to_heading, markdown_get_selection, markdown_read_document, markdown_propose_patch, markdown_apply_patch.
docs: Needs @boring/viewers and @boring/files in your package.json. Uses Tiptap's MIT core, StarterKit, Markdown, Placeholder and task lists only (no Pro extensions).
